verses.text_en:
In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you,
Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance?
And when He launches forth His word against you,
Will you not be affrighted and fear?
verses.text_hr: U one dane, kad na vas spusti žestoki oganj, kamo ćete pobjeći i gdje naći izbavljenje? Kad protiv vas pošalje svoju riječ, nećete li se prestrašiti i uzdrhtati?

verses.text_en:
And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear,
And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.
verses.text_hr: Sva će se svjetlila silno prestrašiti, a sva će zemlja drhtati, tresti se i biti užasnuta.

verses.text_en:
And all the †angels shall execute their commands†
And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory,
And the children of earth shall tremble and quake;
And ye sinners shall be accursed for ever,
And ye shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: I svi će †anđeli izvršiti svoje zapovijedi† I nastojat će se sakriti od prisutnosti Velike Slave, i djeca će zemlje drhtati i tresti se; A vi grešnici bit ćete prokleti zauvijek, i nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en:
Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous,
And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.
verses.text_hr: Ne bojte se, duše pravedne, i nadajte se vi koji ste umrli u pravdi.

verses.text_en:
And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief,
And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness,
But =wait for= the day of the =judgement= of sinners,
And for the day of cursing and chastisement.
verses.text_hr: I ne tuguj ako je tvoja duša u šeol sišla u tuzi, i da u tvom životu tvoje tijelo nije prošlo prema tvojoj dobroti, Ali =čekajte= dan =suda= nad grešnicima, i za dan prokletstva i kazne.

verses.text_en:
And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you:
“As we die, so die the righteous,
And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?
verses.text_hr: Pa ipak, kad umrete, grešnici govore o vama: "Kako mi umiremo, tako umiru i pravednici, i kakvu korist oni ubiru za svoja djela?

verses.text_en:
Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness,
And what have they more than we?
From henceforth we are equal.
verses.text_hr: Gle, kao i mi, tako i oni umiru u tuzi i tami, A što oni imaju više od nas? Od sada smo ravnopravni.

verses.text_en:
And what will they receive and what will they see for ever?
Behold, they too have died,
And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.”
verses.text_hr: I što će primiti i što će zauvijek vidjeti? Gle, i oni su umrli, i od sada zauvijek neće vidjeti svjetlost.”

verses.text_en: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.
verses.text_hr: Kažem vam, vi grešnici, vi ste zadovoljni jesti i piti, i pljačkati i griješiti, i svlačiti ljude do gola, i stjecati bogatstvo i vidjeti dobre dane.

verses.text_en: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?
verses.text_hr: Jeste li vidjeli pravednike kako im kraj pada, da se u njima ne nalazi nikakvo nasilje do smrti njihove?

verses.text_en: “Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.”
verses.text_hr: “Usprkos tome, nestali su i postali kao da ih nije ni bilo, a njihovi su duhovi sišli u šeol u nevolji.”
